title: Taiwanese Overseas Student Association at the University of Washington
content_html:
The Taiwanese Overseas Student Association at the University of Washington (TOSAUW, commonly referred to as TOSA UW) is a nonprofit, student-run registered student organization at the University of Washington. According to the organization’s own website, its primary goal is to promote Taiwanese culture and to serve both undergraduate and graduate students at UW.

TOSA UW hosts cultural, community-based, and social events throughout the year, with the stated aim of enhancing awareness of Taiwanese culture and providing a welcoming space for those interested in learning more about Taiwan. The organization explicitly frames itself as a ‘Home Away From Home’ for international students, and encourages students of all ethnic backgrounds to participate. TOSA UW regularly collaborates with other nonprofit student organizations on campus. Its website copyright line reads ‘© COPYRIGHT 2026,’ indicating active maintenance as of that year.
